pages.text: Many people ask me about this. I want to talk about shares today. I am sceptical and warn that advertised returns are overstated. Read the small print, because returns in adverts are overstated. Your shares and cash settle instantly the moment the trade is matched.

Companies may pay dividends out of profit, but they are not obliged to. Shares represent part ownership of a listed company and are traded through licensed brokers on the exchange. This is only my opinion and you must decide for yourself. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
